info.title: Shotstash REST API
info.description: REST routes of a Shotstash instance: auth, uploads, media, share pages, health and the processing worker contract (v1). Everything else (projects, files, sharing, discussion, jobs in the UI) is GraphQL at /api/graphql; see schema.graphql. Errors answer `{ code, message }` with a stable code. Until first-run setup is done every route except health, config and setup answers 503 SETUP_REQUIRED.

get.description: Public and served before first-run setup. Everyone gets ok and setupRequired and version; a loopback client (the TCP peer, never a forwarded header) or a Bearer session whose account may configure the instance (instance.configure) also gets db and cache and storage and schemeMismatch. 503 carries the same body with ok false.
Liveness answer with the server time; touches no dependency.

post.description: Multipart form with kind (project or user) and file. Project covers need section.create; an avatar needs an active writable account. The image is re-encoded to JPEG; the answer names its cookie-authorised URL under /media/c.
Bearer in and media cookie out: sets shotstash_session (HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/media) for the session of the Bearer token. Browsers call it after sign-in and on boot. No body.
Email and password in and a Bearer token out; also sets the shotstash_session media cookie. Rate limited to 10 attempts per 15 minutes per IP and per email.

401.description: INVALID_CREDENTIALS or another login refusal code

post.description: Revokes the session of the Bearer token and clears the media cookie. No body.

get.description: Public settings the browser needs (app URL and Google client id and feature switches and version and default locale). Public and served before setup; never carries a secret.

post.description: Public demo instances only (SHOTSTASH_DEMO_MODE): a 60-minute session of the read-only demo viewer for the docs try-it console. It never slides; every write with it is refused. Rate limited to 10 per hour per IP. A browser Origin must be the instance itself or listed in SHOTSTASH_CORS_ORIGINS. 404 on every other instance.

SetupRequired.description: SETUP_REQUIRED: first-run setup is not done yet. Every route except health, config and setup answers this until the first super admin exists.

params.description: Free-form parameters given at enqueue (an object).

attempt.description: 1 for the first try, up to `maxAttempts`.

claimToken.description: Send as `X-Claim-Token` on every call for this job.

url.description: Path of the input stream (Range supported).

name.description: Name of the original as uploaded.

size.description: Size of the original in bytes.

versionId.description: Id of the processed version that was created.

expiresAt.description: When the session and the cookie expire (ISO-8601 UTC).

kind.description: `project` (a project cover, needs `section.create`) or `user` (your own avatar).

file.description: The image, at most 10 MiB; re-encoded to JPEG.

expiresAt.description: When the session ends (60 minutes after it was made; it never slides).

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, such as `NOT_FOUND` or `RATE_LIMITED`.

message.description: Human-readable English message; never shown as is to end users.

field.description: The input field the error is about, when there is one.

retryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before trying again (429 answers only; also in `Retry-After`).

details.description: Extra machine-readable details for some codes.

error.description: What went wrong (shown to people with access to the file).

retryable.description: True when another attempt may succeed (the job is requeued while attempts remain).

operationName.description: Which operation of the document to run.

data.description: The result, shaped by the query.

ok.description: True when the database, the cache and storage all answer.

setupRequired.description: True until first-run setup has created the super admin.

version.description: Running version (`SHOTSTASH_VERSION` in the image, else package.json).

db.description: Detailed body only: the database answers.

storage.description: Detailed body only: the storage backend is reachable.

schemeMismatch.description: Detailed body only: the request scheme differs from `APP_URL` (a proxy without `TRUST_PROXY=true`).

name.description: Display name of the worker, such as "reference-proxy".

contract.description: Contract major the worker speaks (1). A string such as "1.2" is read by its major.

manifest.description: What the worker is and does (it may change between heartbeats).

activeJobIds.description: Ids of the jobs the worker is processing; their leases are refreshed.

lostJobIds.description: Ids from `activeJobIds` this worker no longer holds (cancelled, requeued or gone): stop working on them.

token.description: Bearer token for `/api/graphql` and `/api/v1/*`. Keep it secret.

expiresAt.description: When the session expires unless used (ISO-8601 UTC).

avatarUrl.description: Relative URL of the avatar, or null.

accountStatus.description: PENDING accounts may sign in to see the waiting screen.

onboardedAt.description: When onboarding was finished (ISO-8601 UTC), or null.

versionId.description: Id of the stored output (it becomes a processed version on complete).

time.description: Server time in milliseconds since the epoch.

seq.description: Event sequence number of the job (realtime ordering).

appUrl.description: Public URL of the instance, without a trailing slash.

googleClientId.description: Google OAuth client id, or null when Google sign-in is off.

passwordResetEmail.description: Password reset email can be sent.

demo.description: Public demo mode is on (`SHOTSTASH_DEMO_MODE`): read-only demo accounts, nightly reset, sign-up off.

role.description: Role of the account (every demo account is read-only whatever its role).

password.description: Shared password of the demo accounts (public on purpose: the accounts cannot write).
